item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00172","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C22","C21","C05"],"selected_candidate_label":"C22","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C22 plausibly supplied the material drafting template for the child. Both directives respond to threatened labor interruptions by taking possession of private industrial systems through a cabinet secretary and then use the same distinctive administrative sequence: secretary-arranged operation; assistance from public or private instrumentalities and federal agencies; continuation of existing management and ordinary financial operations; preservation of contracts, obligations, dividends, and debt payments; protection of collective bargaining subject to uninterrupted operation; rulemaking and delegation authority; and return or termination of possession when no longer necessary. The child substantially condenses and adapts this machinery from railroads to steel plants. C21 contains essentially the same earlier railroad-seizure template, while C05 applies it to a single railroad and is also strongly parallel.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The Secretary of Commerce is hereby authorized and directed to take possession of all or such of the plants, facilities, and other property ... and to operate or to arrange for the operation thereof","parent_excerpt":"Possession, control, and operation of the transportation systems ... are hereby taken and assumed, through the Secretary of the Army ... The Secretary is directed to operate, or to arrange for the operation of, the transportation systems","explanation":"The core seizure-and-secretary-operated mechanism is directly adapted to a new industry and responsible secretary."},{"child_excerpt":"the Secretary of Commerce may act through or with the aid of such public or private instrumentalities or persons as he may designate; and all Federal agencies shall cooperate with the Secretary of Commerce to the fullest extent possible","parent_excerpt":"the secretary may act through or with the aid of such public or private instrumentalities or persons as he may designate ...
